audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple content fields (whys[0], whys[1], spikes[0].text, early) claim Milio's Q 'cleanses' and 'heals' and call it a leveled 'point' that answers Galio's all-in at level 1-2. Milio's Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick) only knocks back and slows per the kit text — it has no heal or cleanse effect. Cleanse/heal-and-remove-CC is Milio's R (Breath of Life), unavailable before level 6. Separately, Milio's E has 2 charges (not Q), so 'second Q point' should refer to E's second charge.
audit.why: Shipping 'your Q cleanses at level 1' teaches a false mechanic — Q has no cleanse flag and R (the actual cleanse) isn't up that early. This is exactly the class of fabricated-mechanic error called out in the calibration notes.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[0], whys[1], spikes[0].text and early to attribute knockback/slow to Q and shield to E's second charge, removing the false cleanse/heal claim from the early game.
sources: brief ownerKit Q/E/R ability text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: late text says 'With Cosmic Cadence up you cleanse his knockup and taunt' — Cosmic Cadence is not a Milio ability, item, or rune in the kit data or loading text (which lists Cosmic Insight, a different rune, as situational).
audit.why: Unverifiable/likely-fabricated term left as-is would mislead a reader into looking for a nonexistent item or effect.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Cosmic Cadence' with 'Breath of Life (R)', the actual ability that performs the described cleanse.
sources: currentText.full.loading (lists Cosmic Insight, not Cosmic Cadence)
